claims.text: _capture verifies the journal, snapshots it and binds both with a raw-head witness, raising busy if the journal changes during capture.
_prepare_contents rebuilds canonical agent projections, assembles the authority ledger file, scorecard file and a MANIFEST.json with per-file roles.
_export publishes files with exclusive creates, fsyncs children before parents, writes MANIFEST.json last and removes only its own marker on failure.
_destination accepts only exports/ paths whose components pass _safe_component, rejecting traversal and drive-letter shapes.

decision.rule: Change here when export capture, projection comparison, manifest contents, destination rules or publication ordering needs to change.
decision.failure: An export publishes a manifest before files are durable, repairs an existing destination, or follows a symlink during capture.

questions.q: Where does export verify the journal and bind the snapshot to a head witness?
Where should I change the MANIFEST.json roles or file ordering before publication?
Where can I debug a conflict or busy failure during export publication?
